import matplotlib.pyplot as plt 
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')

fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

# Plotting the bar chart for 'Tax Rate %'
ax1.bar(df['Tax Year'], df['Tax Rate %'], color='skyblue', label='Tax Rate %')
ax1.set_xlabel('Tax Year')
ax1.set_ylabel('Tax Rate %', color='blue')
ax1.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='blue')

# Creating a second y-axis for 'Slope'
ax2 = ax1.twinx()
ax2.plot(df['Tax Year'], df['Slope'], color='darkred', marker='o', label='Slope')
ax2.set_ylabel('Slope', color='darkred')
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='darkred')

# Adding legends
ax1.legend(loc='upper left')
ax2.legend(loc='upper right')

# Rotating x-axis labels for better readability
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

plt.title('Tax Rate % and Slope Over Tax Years')
fig.tight_layout()

# Chart INFO: {'x_fields': 'Tax Year', 'y_fields': ['Tax Rate %', 'Slope'], 'chart_type': 'comboChart'}
plt.show()
